name: SolEnrich
description: The onchain intelligence layer for Solana agents. Before your agent trades, one pay-per-call request answers: is this token a rug, is the momentum real, is smart money in it, what will this size cost, and is it time to sell. Covers Solana tokens and wallets, fresh launches, StonkFun reward coins, and perps across six venues. 52 paid endpoints plus 1 free, per-call USDC via x402 on Solana or Base. Operated by Parallax Labs.
